products.title: Siux Electra Pro Shadow Red 2026 - Siux
products.description:
SIUX ELECTRA PRO SHADOW RED 2026 - Professional racket by Franco Stupaczuk. A Premium design model, but with a more discreet aesthetic in black with small red details. One of the best padel rackets on the market for competition. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

Are you a fan of Stupa and want its shovel? The SIUX ELECTRA PRO SHADOW RED 2026 has an engaging design. At the gaming level, a very complete all-terrain racket and Premium materials such as 12K carbon fiber.

PLAYER TYPE

The SIUX ELECTRA PRO SHADOW RED 2026 is an advanced professional racket, aimed at a player profile who knows what they want and has some experience as it will help us achieve our best level and we will adapt quickly to it. Firm response racket, clear control when hitting and the power necessary to accelerate when the point demands it.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

In its construction, the 12K carbon faces stand out, a material that provides rigidity and consistency to achieve a more defined ball output and very stable behavior in strong impacts. The EVA core reinforces that solid feel, offering a harder and more direct touch.

The best thing about this model is its teardrop format with medium balance, which gives us a light swing to increase power in aerial shots. The control on its part is also very good.

The entire surface has a rough matte sandpaper-like finish, designed to increase the grip of the ball and facilitate more marked effects.

At the design level, the Shadow Red is committed to a more serious and aggressive aesthetic, with a modern and minimalist look, it is a lot of overload.

products.title: Nexus Firefight - Nexus
products.description:
NEXUS FIREFIGHT - A teardrop-shaped carbon power racket. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL 

The NEXUS FIREFIGHT is a racket with which your game can shine due to its great power. With a great ball feel, this racket is perfect for all types of intermediate level players, being able to adapt to the conditions of the match at all times.

PLAYER TYPE 

Racquet specially designed for players looking to handle the blow without losing power in each of their blows. Intermediate level.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE 

This racket is characterized by its 3K carbon that provides durability and resistance. Its teardrop/diamond shape helps you have extra power with a more controlled game in the defensive phases of the game. 

Its smooth gloss finish makes its color stand out. Aesthetically it has a modern and striking design. Features a combination of glossy black with neon yellow and white details

PLAY STYLE

The NEXUS FIREFIGHT is designed for a balanced playstyle, albeit with a bias towards power.

products.title: Bullpadel X-compact 2 Yellow - Bullpadel
products.description:
BULLPADEL X-COMPACT 2 YELLOW - Simplicity and quality united in the same padel racket. With this model you will bring out your best version. Introduction

The BULLPADEL X-COMPACT 2 YELLOW is a very complete model, with very good quality materials. This model is very comfortable and allows us to advance in our game, in a very stable and safe way.

This Bullpadel padel racket has a round format, which allows us to have a fairly wide sweet spot. With this we can direct our blows more easily, so we will miss less. This model is also highly requested for its great balance, since we can handle it very comfortably.

Manufacturing components

The BULLPADEL X-COMPACT 2 YELLOW is a very complete model, with top quality materials.

This racket has a highly reinforced structure since its frame is made entirely of carbon, which allows it to not suffer any type of damage, so we will keep it like new for much longer. It also gives us incredible stability in each shot, achieving a more precise game.

The core is made of soft EVA rubber, which is the most requested material on the circuit. This material gives us a great feeling in each blow, making it easier to direct the blows.

Usage level

This BULLPADEL X-COMPACT 2 YELLOW model is designed for intermediate level players who are looking for a quality model that provides a very comfortable game. With this model you will improve your game very easily and quickly.
